# D-MAX Golf Carts

## Models
- GT4 — four-passenger grand touring model, rear-wheel drive, 45 mi estimated range, 25 mph, MSRP $13,595.
- GT6 — six-passenger grand touring model, rear-wheel drive, 45 mi estimated range, 25 mph, MSRP $15,595.
- XT4 — four-passenger Xtreme Terrain model, 4x4 all-wheel drive, 48 mi estimated range, 25 mph, MSRP $15,595.
- XT6 — six-passenger Xtreme Terrain model, 4x4 all-wheel drive, 48 mi estimated range, 25 mph, MSRP $17,595.
